# LibreAgent shipped-library ABI snapshot
# Generated by ci/scripts/abi-snapshot.sh
# '== liblibrescrs-agentclient-qt.so ==': the SONAME, then one demangled
# T-binding symbol of the dynamic table per line, sorted. The 'layout:'
# section is NOT symbols: it records the SHAPE of the public value types
# (size, alignment, member count, per-member byte offsets), because a
# symbol diff is blind to a member added, removed or reordered on a type
# consumers copy by value. A clean symbol diff alone therefore does NOT
# mean 'no ABI impact' — read both. The script's header says what is
# recorded and what is deliberately not.
# Re-generate with: ci/scripts/abi-snapshot.sh --update <build_dir>
# Diff a fresh build against this baseline with: ci/scripts/abi-snapshot.sh --check
